violations.description: Reduced-oxygen packaging. — --Establishment using reduced-oxygen process was not properly labeling the food packages. -All the sliced cheeses prepared by the department store do not have sell-by dates properly labeled. -Mrs. Jerry pasta tubs portioned out by the establishment have expiration dates longer than 10 days. For example, Smoked Gouda Pasta portioned into a new container and labeled by Total Stop Food Store is date marked for September 11th. Today is August 8th.

Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --An approved sanitizer was not used during three compartment sink operation. -It was observed the employee was not using the sanitation solution (which was at proper concentration in a bucket sitting in the third sink) when washing pizza pans.
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
Available, knowledgeable, certified manager (4 pts deducted)
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
